jobs.title: Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
About Squad Health

Squad Health is a healthcare technology company focused on specialty medication access. We help medical practices reduce the administrative friction around benefits investigation, prior authorization, patient assistance, and pharmacy routing so care teams can spend less time on manual work and patients can start therapy faster.

 

We work directly with provider organizations and are building the operating systems, analytics, and cross-functional processes needed to scale that impact across the country.

 

About the Role

We are hiring new team members into our Strategy & Operations team to help build how Squad operates as the company scales. You will work across leadership, Growth, Product, Clinical, and Operations on the highest-leverage business problems that do not sit neatly inside one function.

This is a hands-on operating role. You will move between analysis and execution: identifying bottlenecks in operations and growth, breaking down a problem into root causes, analyzing data and creatively generating solutions, improving operations while implementing system-wide solutions to scale operations to service our growing customer base. Projects may include business planning, operating metrics, resource allocation and management, process redesign, product management, data analysis, and other cross-functional priorities.

 

What You’ll Own

 - Identify operational bottlenecks and redesign workflows so teams can move faster with clearer ownership and fewer manual handoffs.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering to translate operational pain points into automation opportunities and better internal systems.

 - Build and improve the operating cadence, metrics, dashboards, and reporting that give leadership a clear view of performance.

 - Create clear models, decision memos, operating plans, and recommendations from incomplete or messy data.

 - Lead high-priority cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through recommendation, execution, and measurement.

 - Support annual and quarterly planning, forecasting, market research, competitive analysis, and selected strategic projects.

 - Bring structure to ambiguous problems, define the right success measures, and keep stakeholders aligned until the work is complete.

 

What We’re Looking For

 - 5–10 years of experience across management consulting, investment banking, investing, strategy, business operations, or a high-growth technology company.

 - First-principles thinker with strong analytical judgment and the ability to work with imperfect data and identify the real driver of a problem

 - Resourceful: Translate analysis into action and figure out scrappy solutions where the answers are not obvious

 - Action-Biased: High agency and comfort operating without a finished playbook.

 - Systems-Minded: Identifies patterns in long-tail of problems and maps out step-change solutions. Can iterate as required to effectuate a solution to meet near-term timelines.

 - Strong Operator: A track record of owning important projects end-to-end rather than only contributing to one workstream.

 - Strong Communicator: Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to synthesize complex work into a clear recommendation for leadership.

 - Ability to work on-site in New York City.

 

Why Join Squad Health

 - Work on meaningful healthcare problems where better operations can directly reduce delays in patient access to therapy.

 - Join at a stage where you can shape the operating system of the company rather than inherit a finished one.

 - Work closely with leadership and across Product, Growth, Clinical, and Operations on decisions that materially affect how Squad scales.

 - Build toward broader leadership responsibility as the Strategy & Operations function grows.

 

Benefits:

 - 100% employer-paid employee health benefits.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Flatiron office in New York City.

 

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Squad Health is committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace.

jobs.title: Founding Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About Squad Health

Squad Health is building at the forefront of AI and drug innovation tackling large-scale operational challenges with technology, speed, and customer obsession. We move quickly, operate with high ownership, and work closely with customers to solve real-world problems at scale. As we continue to expand, we are looking for exceptional operators in New York who are excited to build, scale, and shape the future of AI-enabled healthcare operations.

 

Joining Squad Health means working on meaningful problems, collaborating with ambitious teams, and having the opportunity to create measurable impact in a rapidly evolving industry.

 

About the Role:

We are hiring a Founding Marketing Lead to build Squad Health’s marketing function from the ground up. This is a hands-on role covering positioning, content, customer proof, conferences, and go-to-market enablement.

You will determine how Squad Health presents itself, which content is worth creating, where we should show up, and how marketing can make our Growth and Partnerships teams more effective. You will work directly with company leadership and partner closely with Product and Operations.

There is no established marketing playbook to inherit. You will have the opportunity to build it.

 

What You’ll Own

 - Positioning and messaging: Build a clear messaging framework for specialty practices, larger provider organizations, and pharmaceutical partners. Translate complex healthcare workflows into language that is simple, credible, and differentiated.

 - Content and thought leadership: Set editorial priorities and produce customer stories, case studies, executive content, product explainers, industry perspectives, webinars, and other materials that build trust and earn attention.

 - Conferences and field marketing: Determine which conferences and specialty meetings warrant investment. Own sponsorship and speaking strategy, executive meetings, pre-event targeting, collateral, on-site execution, follow-up, and ROI analysis.

 - Customer proof and GTM enablement: Turn customer outcomes and market insights into decks, one-pagers, case studies, ROI narratives, specialty-specific messaging, and other materials that strengthen commercial conversations.

 - Launches and market moments: Develop and execute marketing plans for important product releases, customer wins, partnerships, new specialties, and company milestones.

 - Targeted GTM programs: Partner with Growth and Partnerships on focused campaigns, roundtables, webinars, account-based programs, and partner co-marketing tied to commercial priorities.

 - Marketing operations: Build the calendar, briefing process, measurement approach, budget framework, and network of freelancers and agencies needed for a lean team to execute effectively.

 

What We’re Looking For

 - 4+ years of experience across B2B marketing, product marketing, industry marketing, content, field marketing, or go-to-market roles in an early-stage or high-growth environment.

 - Experience as a first or early marketing hire, or ownership of a broad marketing remit without the support of a large team.

 - Exceptional writing and editing skills, including the ability to explain technical or healthcare topics clearly without making them sound generic.

 - Experience developing positioning, customer proof, and sales materials that founders and commercial teams use in real customer conversations.

 - Experience planning and executing conferences or field programs from strategy through follow-up and performance measurement.

 - Strong commercial judgment and an understanding of how marketing contributes to qualified engagement, pipeline, sales effectiveness, and event ROI.

 - Comfort working directly with senior leaders, managing external creative partners when useful, and using AI tools thoughtfully to improve the speed and quality of your work.

 - Based in New York or willing and able to work on-site in New York City.

 

Why Join Squad Health

 - Build the marketing function instead of inheriting an established playbook.

 - Work directly with company leadership and influence how Squad Health is positioned in the market.

 - Own the full path from customer insight to messaging, content, conferences, and commercial conversations.

 - Work on a meaningful healthcare problem where better workflows can help patients begin therapy faster.

 

Benefits

 - 100% employer-paid employee health benefits.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - On-site work from our Flatiron office in New York City.

 

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Squad Health is committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace.

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT SQUAD HEALTH

Squad Health is building at the forefront of AI and drug innovation tackling large-scale operational challenges with technology, speed, and customer obsession. We move quickly, operate with high ownership, and work closely with customers to solve real-world problems at scale. As we continue to expand, we are looking for exceptional operators in New York who are excited to build, scale, and shape the future of AI-enabled healthcare operations.

 

Joining Squad Health means working on meaningful problems, collaborating with ambitious teams, and having the opportunity to create measurable impact in a rapidly evolving industry.

 

Our platform helps medical practices reduce the administrative friction involved in specialty medication access benefits investigation, prior authorization, patient assistance, and pharmacy routing so care teams spend less time chasing workflows and patients start therapy faster. As we expand from individual practices into larger provider organizations, we're building deeper partnerships with health systems, MSOs, and large specialty groups that want to standardize medication-access operations across their networks.

 

THE ROLE

We're hiring a Strategic Partnerships Lead to build and own Squad's enterprise motion across health systems, MSOs, and large specialty groups. Your buyers are hospital COOs, VPs of Revenue Cycle, VPs of Specialty Pharmacy, CMIOs, and physician-group administrators.

 

This is not a role where you inherit a mature territory and run an established playbook there isn't one yet. You'll help decide which organizations matter most, where Squad has the strongest wedge, who needs to believe in the partnership, how the value story changes by stakeholder, and what a successful enterprise rollout looks like. You'll work directly with company leadership and cross-functionally with Product and Operations to move strategic organizations from first conversation through evaluation, agreement, rollout, and expansion.

 

We're intentionally flexible on exact years of experience. What matters most is evidence that you can open complex healthcare organizations, navigate multiple stakeholders, create conviction, and carry a partnership all the way through execution. This is an onsite role based in our New York office we believe the best enterprise partnerships get built in person.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Enterprise account strategy: Identify and prioritize the health systems, MSOs, and large specialty groups where Squad can create the most value; build account plans and stakeholder maps.

 - Open doors and create executive champions: Build relationships with service-line leaders, operators, physicians, pharmacy leadership, and revenue-cycle teams through outbound, warm introductions, and in-person engagement.

 - Discovery and value design: Understand how medication-access work is handled today, where the friction and cost sit, and translate that into Squad's value case for each organization.

 - Navigate complex buying committees: Multi-thread clinical, operational, financial, technical, security, legal, and procurement stakeholders without losing momentum.

 - Structure the partnership: Work with leadership to define scope, rollout model, EMR integration requirements, and success measures for each strategic organization.

 - Drive agreements to completion: Own the path from first meeting through evaluation, proposal, internal alignment, and formal commitment.

 - Quarterback rollout and expansion: Stay close after commitment; coordinate with Product and Operations to clear blockers and set up expansion across sites or specialties.

 - Build the playbook: Turn what works into repeatable account-selection criteria, discovery frameworks, and deal-review processes for the next stage of Squad's growth.

 - Coordinate with the provider-growth/BDR team so individual-practice accounts that grow into multi-site groups get escalated into the enterprise motion at the right time.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

What we're looking for

 - 5+ years across enterprise healthcare sales, strategic partnerships, strategic growth, or business development, with evidence of personally opening and advancing complex relationships with health systems, MSOs, large medical groups, or similarly sophisticated healthcare buyers.

 - A specific, verifiable enterprise deal or partnership you personally sourced and carried from first conversation through close you'll be asked to walk through it.

 - Comfort selling beyond a single champion you can navigate clinical, operational, financial, technical, and executive stakeholders in the same account.

 - Comfort operating in a fast-moving, high-ownership startup environment, including travel as needed for strategic partner meetings and industry events.

 

SKILLS & CAPABILITIES

 - Health-system navigation understands how decisions actually get made inside large provider organizations; can map power, influence, and blockers.

 - Executive discovery asks sharp questions, understands the operating model, and surfaces the real reason an organization would change.

 - Partnership design moves beyond “demo the product” to shape a practical model that works for both organizations.

 - Commercial judgment prioritizes the right accounts and recognizes a real opportunity versus a performative one.

 - Cross-functional leadership aligns Product, Operations, and the customer around one clear path forward without formal authority.

 - Executive communication credible with physicians, operators, and C-suite leaders alike; concise when the room is senior, detailed when execution requires it.

 

WHY JOIN SQUAD HEALTH

 - Build don't inherit. There is no legacy enterprise motion to work within you will design how Squad sells to the largest organizations in specialty medicine.

 - Direct access to founders and leadership. Your deals, judgment calls, and wins are visible at the top of the company from day one.

 - Real equity upside in a company building at the center of AI and specialty medication access a category with no dominant incumbent yet.

 - Genuine ownership of the full arc of a partnership, from identifying the account through rollout and expansion.

 - Work in person, in New York, with a team that believes the best companies are still built in a room together.

 

Benefits

 - Meaningful early-stage equity.

 - 100% employer-paid employee health benefits.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Flatiron office in New York City

 

Equal Opportunity Statement:

 - Squad Health is committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace.
